set.body:
The eight sol<n>_<slug>_agent_sdk and _deep_agents folders return runtime configuration and enforce write scope. They do not drive the loop.

Driving it needs a doer plug. loops/researcher.run already takes a research.Backend object. loops/implementer.run and loops/fixer.run take doer as a string, and loops/enhancer.run has no plug at all.

Widening doers.build to pass a Backend through follows the precedent researcher already sets. The enhancer would need a new plug point in loops/.
